_comment: Mutations applied by tools/mutate.py. Each entry corrupts one fact the
decoder depends on; the suite is expected to notice. An entry reported as
SURVIVED names a fact no test currently constrains -- that is a missing
Keep 'find' strings anchored enough to match exactly once. mutate.py
fails the run if a pattern matches zero times or more than once, so a
refactor that silently stops applying a mutation is caught rather than

mutations.label: crc: polynomial 0x07 -> 0x06
